statement: ∀ b : Basis (Reduction.Ind l) ℂ V, LinearIndependent (Reduction.loc p) b
proof:
run_tac
    let e ← Lean.Elab.Term.elabTerm (← `(@LinearIndependent.restrict_scalars)) none
    Lean.logInfo (← Lean.Meta.inferType e)
  intro b
  exact b.linearIndependent.restrict_scalars' (Reduction.loc p)
